# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-290#publish-frontend-test-proof

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-290#publish-frontend-test-proof (`.planning/seeds/SEED-290-publish-frontend-test-proof.md#publish-frontend-test-proof`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/567-publish-frontend-test-proof/PLAN.md`, revision `0807c542ca67f26adf9f0273d13d934c2e5c31cb`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-290-publish-frontend-test-proof-scratch` (pre-probe: clean product tree at that HEAD; `node_modules` symlink only as scratch dependency setup; execution checkout unused for edits).
- **Promise.** Key example 1 / downloadable frontend-only report with identity: after collection, the attempt offers a dedicated report naming revision/run/attempt (R/7/2), frontend file outcomes and times, without turning browser or backend files into frontend rows, and without executing additional tests.
- **Fault.** In `scripts/frontend-test-proof.mjs` (`identityLines`), removed the `runId`/`runAttempt` (and `attemptId`) identity lines so the Markdown no longer names Run ID or Attempt. Fixture and assertions stayed intact; only production identity rendering changed.
- **Fixture.** `tests/support/ci-proof-frontend-report.test.mjs` case “with frontend-entry the summarize action writes the upload-named report for frontend only”: MakeMe dashboard proof record with frontend pass/fail/other plus browser and backend files; fragments + summarize action replay with `frontend-entry`.
- **Intended assertion.** `assert.match(summary.report, /Run ID: 7/)` at `tests/support/ci-proof-frontend-report.test.mjs:63`. Follow-on `/Attempt: 2/` and frontend-only `doesNotMatch` checks were not reached because this match failed first on the same identity promise.
- **Runs.** Focused command: `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/ci-proof-frontend-report.test.mjs` (AC power; `caffeinate -s -i` available; measured runs used the focused command under `/usr/bin/time -p`).
  - Baseline (pre-fault): silent pass, `time -p` real **0.62 s**, exit 0.
  - Fault: `FAIL` on the intended case; `AssertionError` that `/Run ID: 7/` did not match. Received report kept Repository and Revision but omitted Run ID and Attempt while still listing only frontend file rows — wrong behavior on the intended identity path. Real **0.58 s**, exit 1.
  - Restored: file bytes and SHA-256 matched the recorded original (`8595195369d04204b027ca827174ac9d3b3bfe24e767ac78335c94909ed3420e`); `git status --porcelain` matched pre-probe (`?? node_modules` only) and HEAD `0807c542ca67f26adf9f0273d13d934c2e5c31cb`; same focused command silent pass, real **0.96 s**, exit 0.
- **Finding.** **Caught.** Dropping run/attempt identity from the frontend proof Markdown breaks key example 1’s named R/7/2 report, and the maintained action-replay proof fails on the intended `/Run ID: 7/` assertion.

## Costs

- **Test runtime.** Measured with `/usr/bin/time -p` real on the focused command: baseline 0.62 s; fault 0.58 s; restored 0.96 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported human-effort measure was recorded for this invocation.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 172025 ms (measured), from 1794296373136 to 1794296545161 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
